tools.name: kiyoh_list_locations
tools.description: List the review locations (shops or branches) of the account, with their location ids and rating statistics. Use this first to find the location_id for kiyoh_list_reviews. Send date_since (yyyy-mm-dd) to list locations with reviews created after that date, or updated_since (yyyy-mm-dd) to list locat

tools.name: kiyoh_list_reviews
tools.description: Get all shop reviews of one location: review text, rating and reviewer details as the Kiyoh Publication API returns them. Get location_id from kiyoh_list_locations. Publication API: GET /v1/publication/review/external?locationId=.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: kiyoh_list_locations, kiyoh_list_reviews · Public sink: kiyoh_list_locations.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: kiyoh_list_locations, kiyoh_list_reviews · Public sink: kiyoh_list_locations

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
